name: Paste Ready
tagline: Turns a half-formed bot idea into a paste-ready name, title and description
description: Describe the bot you have in mind, however roughly it comes out, and it works the concept up into three finished fields you can drop straight into the setup form: a name, a title and a description. The aim is a sharp, specific identity for your idea, rather than one more anonymous general-purpose assistant.
author: songsong275452
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
